summary: Shows casting values, such as | bool for a 'True' string from vars_prompt and | int for numeric comparisons on facts.
questions: How do I treat a prompted 'True' string as a boolean?
How do I compare a version fact as a number?

answer_card.title: Forcing data types
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
when: some_string_value | bool
when: ansible_facts['os_family'] == "RedHat" and ansible_facts['lsb']['major_release'] | int >= 6
```
